notes.title: Actually Final Patch
notes.content:
Just a small patch - we've received lots of feedback regarding the tutorial being too wordy, so it's been streamlined. You can replay the tutorial by clicking the button in the options menu if you've already finished it.

Please let us know if you think this new version is an improvement.

Also included is a couple of minor balance changes (notably, the Solar starting ship has the shard cannon moved to the turret slot for a much easier initial experience), and a fix for the HUD disappearing on level retries.

notes.title: Final Patch Before Early Access
notes.content:
Barring any fatal bugs, this will be the last patch before Early Access. The playtest will be turned off to public access at that point, likely this weekend.

This patch finishes the Steam integration - all your resources and unlocks now sync with Steam. This does mean you'll be starting again from scratch, however, so apologies for that.

You'll notice also that the ships now have a cost to unlock, and the missions also now need to be unlocked in order (kill a medium or above boss on a level to unlock the next).

Thanks once again to all our wonderful testers. Click the copyright text on the main screen to see who they were :P

notes.title: Third round of improvements
notes.content:
- You can now actually buy global upgrades! Sorry about that all :P
- The upgrade shop interface is hopefully a bit clearer now
- The pause/end game summary screen now shows resources collected for that level so far

All of these combined should hopefully make it a bit more obvious how the global upgrade resource collection works!

- Mines now have a lifetime of thirty-seconds.
- The invulnerability of phase shift now lasts for a short time after the movement speed ends.

Thank you once more to all our wonderful testers :D

notes.title: Second Round of Improvements
notes.content:
This should be the last of the UI fixes

- Finally fixed pause mode and steam overlay interactions
- The entire game should now be playable with a controller from start to finish. Those of you with joypads please try and make sure you get to all the buttons and options without using the mouse.

Thanks again for the playtesting!

Next update will be some updates to the levels. Once that's been tested and bugs fixed we'll close the playtest and move into the early access.

notes.title: First round of improvements
notes.content:
Thanks to all our initial testers. Excellent feedback from everyone to start :)

[list]
[*] There is now a toggle option for confirmation when selecting upgrades
[*] There is now a back button in the weapon loadout screen if you decide you don't want that weapon after all
[*] There is now a toggle option to turn the pixel shader effects on and off for slower machines
[*] Upgrades costs in the shop (and your current resource total) is shown below each upgrade
[*] You can actually now die again... *cough*
[/list]
